name: D-2 export() pagination cap + integration tests 2026-08-14
description: Address gap D-2 from visibility doc 2026-08-12-visibility-shared-http-client-dynamo-refactoring.md §5.3: EnhancedDynamoRepository.export(projectionExpression, limit) auto-paginates the whole table via the enhanced client's lazy PageIterable, ignoring the intended total cap and with a misleading Javadoc. Fix: treat limit as a total result cap using the same lazy early-return pattern proven in query() (ION-16431); correct the Javadoc. Add DynamoDB-Local integration tests verifying export cap + projection behavior. Follows-on from rebase session 5fab7d4aa9ff4d22.

entries.summary: Resumed after server error. Confirmed export() source fix is present but uncommitted; remaining work is integration tests.
entries.detail: git status shows EnhancedDynamoRepository.java modified (uncommitted). Diff confirms export(projectionExpression, limit) now: (1) treats limit as total result cap via lazy early-return over table.scan() pages (same pattern as query()), (2) corrected Javadoc, (3) capped ArrayList presize. findAll() unpaginated still guarded by isFindAllUnpaginatedScanEnabled() (out of scope per doc, default off). Next: add DynamoDB-Local integration tests verifying export cap + projection.

entries.summary: D-2 integration tests added and passing (61 completed, 0 failures). Doc created.
entries.detail: Added @Nested ExportIntegrationTests (12 tests) to EnhancedDynamoRepositoryIT covering: limit null=all; limit<,=,>total; non-positive limit {0,-1,-100} parameterized => unbounded; empty table => empty; projection populates only requested attrs (data/tags/attributes null); projection parsing tolerates blank/embedded/trailing-empty segments; blank projection => full items; projection + cap combined. Added ValueSource import. Ran: mvn -pl cloud-sdk-aws -am verify -Dit.test=EnhancedDynamoRepositoryIT with failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false flags. failsafe-summary.xml: completed=61, failures=0, errors=0, skipped=0. All pass. Created cloud-sdk-aws/docs/2026-08-14-export-total-cap-integration-tests.md.
